name: zmath_vec3_direction_angles_between_points
description: zMath::Vec3DirectionAnglesBetweenPoints computes pitch/yaw direction angles from pointA to pointB, clears roll, and returns outAngles.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this trigonometric helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zMath vector/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja evidence for 0x474d10 validates delta.x=pointA.x-pointB.x, delta.y=pointB.y-pointA.y, delta.z=pointA.z-pointB.z, yaw=atan2(delta.x, delta.z), pitch=atan2(delta.y, sqrt(delta.x*delta.x+delta.z*delta.z)), outAngles.z=0, and returning outAngles.
The native smoke verifies the return pointer and a representative direction-angle result.
